workload: Generalize a public byte-hash input to borrowed AsRef containers. Existing array and slice callers can instantiate different generic ABIs; all four original hashfn tests remain unchanged.
cpu_accounting: RUSAGE_CHILDREN deltas around one waited-for child tree at a time; user plus system CPU; excludes harness CPU
